Teenage Cricketer Makes History as India's Youngest International Debutant

Vaibhav Sooryavanshi, a 15-year-old cricketer, made history by becoming India's youngest-ever international cricketer. He achieved this feat during his T20I debut against England, where he scored 14 runs and became the first Indian to be stumped on debut. This record surpasses Sachin Tendulkar's 36-year-old debut age record.
